mechanism: Cenobamate is a potent CYP3A4 inducer that may increase tenofovir metabolism, while both drugs can affect renal function and require monitoring in patients with compromised renal clearance.
action: Monitor tenofovir efficacy and renal function (creatinine clearance, phosphate levels) regularly; consider therapeutic drug monitoring if available; ensure adequate hydration and assess for signs of tenofovir toxicity.
